sources.title: Summary figures supplied in chat (August vs September completed requests)

decisions.question: No raw case-level export was supplied (only two aggregate means and counts). Can raw records (per-case created/completed timestamps, complexity tag, assignee, workflow version) be exported so cycle time can be stratified by complexity and checked for duplicates/outliers instead of compared as two bare means?

The comparison conflates a 3x volume increase (10→30 completed requests) and a reported rise in case complexity with a manager change. Attribution of the +2 day mean cycle-time increase to the new manager's performance cannot be established from these two aggregates alone — what complexity metric or tag exists (or should be introduced) to separate volume/complexity effects from manager-attributable effects?
